head.kicker: Players by part of the event and the round
head.title: Best and worst in every split
head.sub: Every dot is a qualified player on the split’s headline number, worse to the left, better to the right; the top three in their tour colour, the bottom three in coral. Tap a split for its top five and bottom three.

metric.label: SG, rounds 1-2
metric.tip: Rounds 1 and 2: before the cut, in a full field.

stats.label: SG/rd
stats.tip: Strokes gained per round against an average field over the window, shrunk toward the peer average.

stats.label: Cuts made
stats.tip: Cuts made per start in events with a cut, shrunk the same way.

stats.label: Spread
stats.tip: One standard deviation of the player's strokes gained from round to round, after their own average: lower is steadier.

metric.label: SG, weekend
metric.tip: Rounds 3 and 4: after the cut, usually in contention or chasing.

stats.label: SG/rd
stats.tip: Strokes gained per round against an average field over the window, shrunk toward the peer average.

stats.label: Top 10s
stats.tip: Top-10 finishes (ties included) per start, shrunk the same way.

stats.label: Wins
stats.tip: Wins per start, shrunk toward the peer rate (ten starts of weight).

metric.label: SG, front nine
metric.tip: The front nine against the field's average front nine that day (strength-adjusted, like every number here).

stats.label: SG/rd
stats.tip: Strokes gained per round against an average field over the window, shrunk toward the peer average.

stats.label: Back nine
stats.tip: The back nine, the same way. Front plus back is the round.

stats.label: Great rds
stats.tip: Share of rounds three or more strokes better than an average field would have shot.

metric.label: SG, back nine
metric.tip: The back nine, the same way. Front plus back is the round.

stats.label: SG/rd
stats.tip: Strokes gained per round against an average field over the window, shrunk toward the peer average.

stats.label: Front nine
stats.tip: The front nine against the field's average front nine that day (strength-adjusted, like every number here).

stats.label: Poor rds
stats.tip: Share of rounds three or more strokes worse.

notes: Each week's ranking is the one after that week's finished events; Now adds any finished since. A player without a start since keeps the same rating and moves only when others pass.
The top 100 of the ranking (the ranking's own rule: enough recent rounds behind the rating). Colours only tell the lines apart.
Groups: strokes gained by part of the event and of the round, for the regulars (30+ rounds in two years); the LPGA publishes no season statistics for our categories.
